scope: Bind raw-preserved DXF entity common group-8 LAYER and group-6 LTYPE names to a unique qualified row in the TABLES body staged by the same output attempt.

implementation.fieldScope: Inspect group 8 and group 6 only in the raw entity common AcDbEntity scope. Application groups and XDATA are excluded because their group-code meanings are not established as entity symbol references.
implementation.textIdentity: Decode the exact string bytes selected for output with source and target DRW_TextCodec profiles. Require valid text and the same conservative symbol key: ASCII letters compare case-insensitively, while non-ASCII UTF-8 must match byte-for-byte. Unknown source versions admit ASCII-only names. No raw group bytes are rewritten.
implementation.targetIdentity: Inspect the staged TABLES body and require exactly one qualified emitted LAYER or LTYPE row for each referenced case-folded symbol key. Missing, duplicate, malformed, unqualified, or codepage-shifted targets refuse the file transaction before publication.
implementation.transaction: The table inspector is enabled whenever raw entity carriers exist and runs before entity sections. A corrected source carrier can retry on the same adapter after a refused attempt.

validation.result: Build passed with -Werror. The three focused tests passed (3/3, 1.72 seconds total). The generated AC1027 control ran in ASCII and Binary: missing common LAYER and LTYPE names refused while preserving a sentinel destination; correcting group 8 then group 6 on the same adapter succeeded; the ASCII-case-insensitive source spelling `continuous` resolved to the emitted Continuous row; readback preserved both common names and unresolved nested application-group values. Existing raw-carrier capture-limit and source-table identity controls also passed.
validation.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or modified. Generated output lived in a temporary directory and was removed by the test.

limitations: Generated AC1027 adapter evidence only; no physical whole-source DWG/DXF conversion is qualified.
The carrier has name references rather than source symbol handles; this proves unique emitted name-row closure, not source-handle identity or table membership provenance.
Application-group and XDATA fields, broader source codepages/revisions, producer ordering, Unicode case-insensitive matching, native linetype rendering, and whole-document completeness remain open.
No support claim is promoted by this generated control.
